tools.name: sellapp_list_products
tools.description: List the store's products, 15 per page. Filter by visibility, drafts or whether a product has sales. Sell.app API: GET /v2/products.

tools.name: sellapp_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by its numeric ID. Sell.app API: GET /v2/products/{product}.

tools.name: sellapp_list_orders
tools.description: List the store's orders, 15 per page. Results include customer and payment summaries without sensitive data. Sell.app API: GET /v2/orders.

tools.name: sellapp_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by its numeric ID, with totals in minor units, status timeline and line-item summaries. Sell.app API: GET /v2/orders/{order}.

tools.name: sellapp_list_disputes
tools.description: List the store's payment disputes (chargebacks), most recent first, 50 per page. Sell.app API: GET /v2/disputes.

tools.name: sellapp_list_license_keys
tools.description: List license keys issued by the store, 15 per page. Filter by key text, customer email, product or order. Sell.app API: GET /v2/license-keys.

tools.name: sellapp_get_license_key
tools.description: Get one license key by its numeric ID. Sell.app API: GET /v2/license-keys/{license_key}.

tools.name: sellapp_list_coupons
tools.description: List the store's coupon codes, 15 per page. Sell.app API: GET /v2/coupons.

tools.name: sellapp_get_coupon_usage
tools.description: Get the usage record of one coupon by its numeric ID. Sell.app API: GET /v2/coupons/{coupon}/usage.

tools.name: sellapp_get_store_settings
tools.description: Get the store configuration and status flags. Secret analytics credentials appear only as configured yes/no values. Sell.app API: GET /v2/store/settings.

tools.name: sellapp_get_permissions
tools.description: Show which abilities and store permissions the API key has for this store. Sell.app API: GET /v2/permissions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "sellapp_get_store_settings" references sensitive artifacts (credentials, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get the store configuration and status flags. Secret analytics credentials appear only as configured yes/no values. Sell.app API: GET /v2/store/settings.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sellapp_list_license_keys · Private data: sellapp_get_coupon_usage, sellapp_get_store_settings, sellapp_get_permissions · Public sink: sellapp_list_license_keys.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sellapp_list_license_keys · Private data: sellapp_get_coupon_usage, sellapp_get_store_settings, sellapp_get_permissions · Public sink: sellapp_list_license_keys

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
